name: allice
description: All ice — App de gestión de visitas y ventas

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.vercel-build: npm install --prefix backend && npx prisma generate --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
